name: Drill Bit Holder
subtitle: Compact seven-bit fractional index
description: A compact one-row holder for 1/8, 5/32, 3/16, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, and 1/2 inch drill bits, with rounded corners and softened outer and hole-entry edges.

dimensionTargets: Seven blind holes fit 1/8, 5/32, 3/16, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, and 1/2 inch drill bits in increasing-size order.
Each default hole adds 0.5 mm diametral clearance to its bit diameter.
Adjacent nominal holes have 3 mm of material between them.
The default holder is approximately 76.3 mm long, 19.6 mm wide, and 24 mm high.
Blind holes are 20 mm deep and retain a 4 mm floor.
invariants: Keep all seven bit sizes fixed and ordered from smallest to largest along one row.
Derive every hole diameter from its bit diameter plus the shared diametral clearance.
Derive the box length and width from the hole set, spacing, and fixed compact side wall.
Keep every hole blind with at least the configured minimum floor thickness.
Round all four plan corners and bevel the outer top and bottom edges.
Bevel each hole entry without reducing the remaining top web below the printable minimum.
Preserve one closed, support-free shell resting flat on Z=0.

scripts.name: audit
scripts.description: Validates the seven fixed bit sizes, compact derived envelope, blind-hole floor, bevel clearances, and STL topology.
